getstatistics.name: GetStatistics
getstatistics.description: Grants permission to retrieve aggregate statistics over AWS WAFv2 request logs within a specified time window

getstatisticstimeseries.name: GetStatisticsTimeSeries
getstatisticstimeseries.description: Grants permission to retrieve time-bucketed statistics over AWS WAFv2 request logs within a specified time window
